The use of GitHub URLs and checksums is standard for AUR packages, and while checksums are provided and match the expected releases, their presence or absence does not affect the safety of this specific command. No data exfiltration or remote code execution can occur during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

The structure follows typical AUR packaging patterns without any obfuscation or suspicious logic. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no immediate risk.
</details>
